run_bin_to_vec: run the script to print a fasttext .vec file to stdout from a .bin model file
load_model: load a fasttext model from a .bin file using the load_model function
get_words: get all words from a loaded fasttext model using the get_words method
get_word_vector: get the vector representation of a word from a fasttext model using get_word_vector
get_dimension: get the dimension of word vectors from a loaded fasttext model using get_dimension
